basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old music enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer and have a deep passion for video game soundtracks and collectible vinyl records. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new music genres and participating in online game communities. I'm single and usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a degree from a local university. My interest in video game soundtracks started in college, where I began collecting vinyl records and diving deep into the indie game scene. I am mostly self-taught in negotiation skills, which I practice in my freelance work.
